caption: The drawing features two primary objects and an inset diagram. The first object, positioned in the upper center, is a cup-shaped vessel with thick walls, a broad rim, and a rounded base that flares out at the bottom; it is colored in shades of brown with a textured appearance, possibly suggesting metal or ceramic material. Below this vessel, a cylindrical rod with one end thicker and rounded, tapering slightly toward the other end, is depicted horizontally; it is similarly colored in brown hues and has a slightly mottled texture. In the bottom right corner, there is a small inset illustration showing outline sketches of the same two objects, annotated with dimensions “6” (height of the vessel), “6” (diameter of the vessel), and “13” (length of the rod). The objects are set against a plain, off-white background bordered by a single-line rectangular frame.
title: Mortar and Pestle
